answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared registry before it can trade. Reputation accrues slowly like pigment soaking into basalt: each verified delivery dyes the agent's record a little deeper, and the record is a single thread no identity can split or duplicate. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake agent and wait out the same slow dyeing process, so cloning identities costs real capital and time while honest agents keep the stake they already earned.
